hooks.text: 旋转符文列匹配五条法术线并锁定八枚符文
hooks.excerpt: Cast spells to attack enemies by spinning Rune Columns like slot reels. Match results along five Spell Lines to deal damage. Strategically lock up to 8 Runes in place while others spin for better control.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 像构筑牌组一样增删改符文并叠加护符光环
hooks.excerpt: Customize rune columns in a deck-building experience to suit your strategy. Add, remove, and modify Runes for personalized gameplay. Enhance runes with amulets and auras for additional effects when cast.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 150种饰品叠出触发组合并用强敌换商店资金
hooks.excerpt: Explore 150 Trinkets to discover synergies and crazy combos. Increase damage and damage multipliers. Trigger Runes multiple times. Gain extra Rune holds. Make Runes match with different elements. Choose starting enemies with unique abilities, balancing risk and reward. Earn coins for defeating stronger foes and spend them across five specialized shops.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
